texts.orig: The paper is organized as follows: In section 2, we introduce Bayesian inversion framework and the Fisher information adaptive MALA. We outline the finite-dimensional Bayesian approach, describe the Fisher adaptive MALA process, and develop the convergence analysis. Section 3 presents numerical experiments for Bayesian inverse problems that demonstrate the effectiveness of this algorithm and compare its performance with other methods. Section 4 concludes the paper with a summary of the main findings and a discussion of potential directions for future research.
